rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 15 October 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 HKMA announced the Chongqing–Hong Kong Cross-boundary Data Validation Platform for initial account-opening and loan-application use cases. It creates a potential commercial and operational option for cross-boundary SME onboarding and lending, but does not state a bank participation requirement or timetable. Hong Kong 🟡 Chongqing–Hong Kong Cross-boundary Data Validation Platform 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20261014-hkma-press-ad903718c6 ⏰ Deadline: No source deadline stated Products: SME onboarding, Lending, Cross-border data validation The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) announced the launch of the Chongqing–Hong Kong Cross-boundary Data Validation Platform on 14 October 2026. The platform verifies customer-presented data using blockchain technology and hash values without transferring or storing the original documents across the boundary. It will initially support cross-boundary financial use cases, while banks in Chongqing and Hong Kong are advancing Northbound and Southbound account-opening and loan-application use cases. The announcement states no participation requirement, implementation timetable, or prescribed standards for reliance, consent, underwriting or data protection; institutions considering participation may assess data flows, validation reliance and operator arrangements before making a commercial decision. Source: HKMA welcomes launch of Chongqing-Hong Kong Cross-boundary Data Validation Platform Mainland/GBA • No separate Mainland/GBA regulatory items in this edition. SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. • No benchmark items in this edition. Watch List • Monitor any published participation, access, consent, liability, security, retention and cross-boundary-data terms for the platform.
